references.text: Isaiah prophesies about the coming of John the Baptist and his role as one who prepares the way for the Lord.
Jesus identifies John as 'the Elijah who was to come' according to prophecy.
The disciples' question about Elijah and Jesus' explanation pointing to John the Baptist's role and fate.
A parallel discussion in Mark about Elijah and how John fulfills this role.
Luke describes the angel's words to Zechariah about John, and how he will go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah.
Jesus describes John as 'more than a prophet' and refers to Malachi 3:1.
The prophet Malachi predicts Elijah who is to come before the great and dreadful day of the Lord.
Malachi prophesies about Elijah who will come to turn the hearts of fathers to their children and the hearts of children to their fathers.
